diagnosis: The HLS video segment streaming endpoint pipes live media segments from disk via a PassThrough stream based solely on req.params.streamSessionId. It never verifies whether the requesting client has an active subscription or purchase entitlement for the stream, allowing unauthorized users to siphon premium live video streams.
